programs.title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
programs.desc: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

programs.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
programs.desc: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programs.title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
programs.desc: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programs.desc: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
programs.desc: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

programs.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
programs.desc: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

programs.title: Alex Malt: Solved Mysteries
programs.desc: Boston-born comedian, Alex Malt tackles social anxiety, going to rehab, living in California, getting married and more in his first stand-up comedy special! What didn't kill him may not have made him stronger, but it definitely made him funnier!

programs.title: Andy Kindler: I Wish I Was Bitter
programs.desc: The comic shares his thoughts on some of the big-name comics of the day.

programs.title: Richard Jeni: Platypus Man
programs.desc: The Brooklyn-born comedian performs.

programs.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry
programs.desc: Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

programs.title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
programs.desc: Chris Porter discusses everything from hipsters ruining food, to being a man, to playing beer pong with celebrities, in his 3rd one-hour special.

programs.title: Danny Bhoy: Subject to Change
programs.desc: The comic performs.

programs.title: Dom Irrera: Live From Las Vegas
programs.desc: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy.

programs.title: Tommy Davidson: Illin' in Philly
programs.desc: The comic performs at Philadelphia's Shubert Theater.

programs.title: Tommy Davidson: Takin' It to D.C.
programs.desc: Comic Tommy Davidson at George Washington University in Washington, D.C.

programs.title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
programs.desc: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

programs.title: Denise Winkelman: Bougie on a Budget
programs.desc: Denise Winkelman mixes sharp wit and heartfelt humor as she shares her journey from a small town with hick parents to life as a transgender woman in Los Angeles, turning struggles into comedy.

programs.title: Gary Owen: Black Famous
programs.desc: This last year has been unlike any other: COVID, lockdowns, and for Gary, it has also included a divorce and family insanity unlike any other; up until now, Gary hasn't been able to speak about what really happened.

programs.title: Russell Peters: Deported
programs.desc: The comic explores his life as a middle-aged man dealing with health issues, relationships and fatherhood, while interacting with the sold-out audience at NSCI Stadium in Mumbai, India.

programs.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
programs.desc: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

programs.title: Maria Bamford: Weakness Is the Brand
programs.desc: Maria Bamford, star of the "Lady Dynamite" TV series, performs standup comedy.

programs.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
programs.desc: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programs.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
programs.desc: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

programs.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
programs.desc: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

programs.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
programs.desc: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

programs.title: Gina Yashere: Skinny B...tch
programs.desc: The comic discusses weight loss.

programs.title: Gina Brillon: Pacifically Speaking
programs.desc: Comic Gina Brillon performs.

programs.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
programs.desc: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

programs.title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness
programs.desc: From growing up in Northern Virginia to feeling unsafe in his new home in New York, Andrew's charming world view shines through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps and first loves.

programs.title: Jay Mohr: Altamont
programs.desc: Comic Jay Mohr tackles subjects ranging from unexpected visitors to bringing up children and working with Chris Farley on "Saturday Night Live."

programs.title: Jay Mohr: American Treasure
programs.desc: Comedian Jay Mohr shares hilarious observations and personal glimpses into his life.

programs.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Plastic Cup Boyz
programs.desc: Stand-up comics Joey Wells, Will Horton and Na'im Lynn make up the Plastic Cup Boyz, who have opened for Kevin Hart for many years, but now they step into the spotlight with headlining sets of their own.

programs.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Keith Robinson Back of the Bus Funny
programs.desc: Keith Robinson describes the long-term dangers of being racist, the pitfalls of aging and the difference between the ways that men and women cheat.

programs.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
programs.desc: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

programs.title: Michael Yo: Blasian
programs.desc: Michael Yo brings his personal blend of comedy to his debut stand up special; born and raised in Houston, Michael talks about growing up mixed in a place where he really stood out.

programs.title: Natasha Pearl Hansen: I Was Supposed to Get Married Today
programs.desc: After postponing her wedding for the third time, comedian Natasha Pearl Hansen takes the stage at her wedding venue to deliver a funny and poignant reflection on her "special day" in front of family, friends, and those who "saved the date."

programs.title: Rachel Scanlon: Gay Fantasy
programs.desc: Buckle up for a big gay comedy ride with comedian Rachel Scanlon in this special for some unbridled fun; Ray unpacks the life of a powerful soft butch lesbian from hot tub trauma with her big, fat, religious family.

programs.title: Tom Papa: Human Mule
programs.desc: Comedian Tom Papa returns to Cleveland while relating the everyman struggles of family life, falling behind to the super rich and his hilarious cure for angry young men.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
programs.desc: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
programs.desc: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham: I'm With Cupid
programs.desc: Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
programs.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.
